Welcome to @dvmcellini — veterinary neurology explained by a real neurologist.

I'm Dr. James Cellini, a board-certified vet neurologist (DVM, DACVIM) with over 15 years of experience diagnosing and treating dogs and cats with neurological conditions. This channel exists because pet parentrs and vets deserve clear, trustworthy answers regarding neurologic conditions.

On this channel you'll find:
🧠 Plain-English explanations of seizures, IVDD, disc disease, strokes, vestibular disease, wobbler syndrome, and more
🐾 What to expect when your pet is referred to a neurologist
🎓 Clinical education for vet students, general practitioners, ER vets, and vet techs
📋 Real answers to the questions families ask me every day in the exam room

New videos every week.

👇 Subscribe so you never miss a new video.

📩 Brand & partnership inquiries: dvmcellini@gmail.com
